description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode, +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Holy Ability Boost, Triplecast Holy, Unlimited Holy Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Holy Abilities, Holy Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Holy Abilities; Ends after using 8 Holy abilities
TP Max: AOE Holy/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text:
Single-target Holy/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Holy Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/3 En-Holy
WS Blue: Lv.3 En-Holy Stack to user
WS Gold: 30% Surging Power for 6 turns to all allies
